correctness.rationale: The greedy-arch argument proves equivalence with the exact fixed-ambient-alphabet universality index. Maximum disjoint alphabet-complete interval packing and earliest greedy endpoints prove the midpoint criterion in both directions for every even q and every fixed-point-free involution. Stirling-surjection generating functions count arches and proper-alphabet remainders exactly; hitting all involution pairs yields the R_q term. The geometric series and minimal-word factorization give all asserted formulas. Exact symbolic simplification checks the four-letter rational function. The embedded independent finite diagnostic checks 189008 half-words and the defining subsequence predicate on 368 selected cases; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

evidence: Barker et al. show a universality-index relation for ordinary palindrome halves and for repeated words under symbol permutations; their work does not provide this symmetry-class rational generating function.

Adamson et al. give algorithmic counts for regular languages via finite automata; unrestricted reverse-complement palindromes across all lengths form a nonregular language, and the displayed exact distribution is not in their Section 4.
Fleischmann et al. study Simon congruence classes, rather than counts by exact index of reverse-complement fixed points.
broader_coverage.reasoning: More general arch methods and counting algorithms are relevant antecedents, but their stated theorems neither directly subsume the all-even-alphabet exact paired-symmetry count nor give the sharp number of minimal-length symmetric universal words. The proof explicitly credits these inputs instead of presenting the arch method as new.

originality.rationale: The relevant full-text sections of the two closest broadly relevant papers and a published exact binary count were compared statement by statement. Known palindrome/permutation arch lemmas are credited, but no inspected stronger published theorem supplies the all-even-alphabet reverse-complement distribution or the sharp minimal-word multiplicities. Search is not proof of worldwide uniqueness; the strongest residual risk is an unindexed equivalent extension of arch midpoint arguments.

value.rationale: The reverse-complement symmetry class is natural for paired alphabets such as DNA and is nonregular as an all-length language. The theorem gives a complete exact two-variable distribution for every even q, an unusually compact quaternary rational specialization, and a sharp, all-index minimal-length enumeration that distinguishes even and odd indices. These exact natural invariants have direct combinatorial use beyond code reproducibility, and no empirical DNA effect is claimed.
